title: Business and Technical Examination Registration
description: Internal comparison of Business and Technical programmes and series. Use scoped records for future public answers.
clarifying_questions: Which candidate type, programme or assessment pathway?

claims.text: Registration windows: November 2026 series, 6 July-11 September 2026; March 2027, 2 November 2026-8 January 2027; July 2027, 1 March-7 May 2027. Check subsequent amendments.
Institutions handle registration. Online upload and payment alone do not complete registration; submission of registration materials is also required.
Entry requirements depend on programme and level. Confirm the specific syllabus and prerequisite qualification.
Principals generate an examination-fee invoice and follow the registration-platform link for payment through eCitizen.
Referred Business TEP candidates may register at their former institution or another KNEC centre approved to offer the referred papers.
The circular directs Business and Technical results and certificate queries through QMIS.

For Business Single and Group Stage I, Table 3 lists a basic fee of KES 1,200 per candidate and a paper fee of KES 500. These components are not a complete individual invoice; confirm papers and any applicable additional charges.

For Business Single and Group Stage II, Table 3 lists a basic fee of KES 1,200 per candidate and a paper fee of KES 550. These components are not a complete individual invoice; confirm papers and any applicable additional charges.

For Technical/TEP/TVET Higher Diploma, Table 3 lists a basic fee of KES 1,600 per candidate and a paper fee of KES 1,600. These components are not a complete individual invoice; confirm papers and any applicable additional charges.

For Technical Higher Diploma, old syllabus, Table 3 lists a basic fee of KES 1,600 per candidate and a paper fee of KES 1,700. These components are not a complete individual invoice; confirm papers and any applicable additional charges.
Table 3 lists Artisan project and practical charges of KES 400 each; Craft/Diploma/Higher Diploma project and practical charges are KES 450 each. Apply only the relevant components.
The circular lists a KES 450 search fee per repeated paper.
